title: Northstar synthetic plan: eligibility
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. Northstar Benefits Plan eligibility begins with regular full-time employees scheduled for at least 30 hours per week. A newly eligible employee may enroll starting on the first calendar day after completing 30 days of employment. Enrollment must be submitted within 31 days of that eligibility date. Coverage for a dependent begins on the same effective date as the employee's coverage when the dependent is listed and approved during enrollment. A spouse or domestic partner must be reported accurately; this sample does not define tax treatment or legal eligibility. Dependent children may remain on the plan through age 25 and lose eligibility on their 26th birthday, subject to applicable law and employer verification. This fictional plan has no part-time, contractor, retiree, or international employee coverage rule. When a real situation does not match this narrow synthetic statement, the assistant must not guess: it should identify the missing condition and direct the reader to a plan administrator. The text is authored solely for testing document retrieval and citations. It does not describe any real employer, carrier, benefits contract, or person.
